title: GitHub Trending Summary - Weekly - 2026-10-23
ranking_basis: Weekly GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending
ranking_explanation: Repositories were ordered by the stars gained values displayed in GitHub Trending's weekly view; REST API metadata was used to corroborate current repository totals, language, default branch, and commit SHA.
global_caveat: GitHub REST corroboration cannot independently reproduce historical weekly star gains. The +106,341 displayed for morluto/rea is a pronounced outlier; treat Trending gains as platform signals, not a stable growth rate.

sections.title: Snapshot

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: The week is dominated by agent-facing developer tools, led by morluto/rea at +106,341 stars; local creative-media tooling and portable skills are also prominent. The leading gain is an outlier, so read it as GitHub Trending momentum rather than a typical repo growth rate.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Agent-assisted and established reverse engineering:** REA combines agent-facing MCP/CLI workflows for app, runtime, and binary inspection; Ghidra remains a full-featured platform for disassembly, decompilation, and scripted analysis.
- **Coding-agent workbenches and orchestration:** Orca and OpenCode emphasize agent workspaces and selectable modes, while RuFlo targets multi-agent orchestration; the weekly list signals demand for both individual coding agents and multi-agent execution.
- **Portable agent skills and plugin ecosystems:** Anthropic, Cursor, Android, and K-Dense package reusable extensions or domain workflows, showing platform-specific marketplaces alongside portable skill standards.
- **Agent-native interfaces, context, and memory:** CLI-Anything makes software accessible through command-line harnesses; ai-memory carries context across agents and projects; context-mode targets tool-output routing and context reduction.
- **Local and programmable creative media:** VoiceStudio centers local speech production, HyperFrames renders agent-authored HTML into video, and ComfyUI exposes generative media through reusable node graphs and local inference.
- **Languages:** TypeScript: 7; Python: 5; Java: 1; Kotlin: 1; Rust: 1 repositories (15 listed).

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Agent infrastructure is broadening from coding assistants into reverse engineering, software control, memory, and installable workflow skills. At the same time, local and programmable creative tools remain a strong independent cluster. The star-gain leader is exceptionally far ahead of the rest, so the week is better read as a sharp signal around one breakout project plus several reinforcing themes.
